messages:
Sam S.: FYI AcmeCorp flagged a month-end mismatch for Feb close — invoice total is $1,187.34 more than the dashboard. They say invoice shows 1,204,567 tokens on the 'generation' line but dashboard shows 980,432. Account acme-corp-42, invoice INV-2024-02-42. Can someone triage?

Maria B.: Bumping — can you paste sample request_ids or a narrow time window? Also did they change plans mid-cycle? :eyes:

Sam S.: Good q — they upgraded from Pro -> ProPlus on 2024-02-20 12:03 UTC via our subscription API. Narrow window is 2024-02-20 00:00:00 -> 2024-02-22 00:00:00. Sample request_ids from their support logs: r_9f3a1b, r_d2b7c0, r_1a7c9f.

Anya (eng): Thx. I'll run a quick diff between raw_events and billing_agg for that window. Possible culprits: double-ingest of batch embed jobs or proration bug on mid-cycle plan change.

Leo F.: Can you run this query on billing_warehouse? should show where tokens diverge:

```sql
SELECT day, source, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM (
  SELECT DATE(ts) as day, 'raw' as source, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM raw_events WHERE account_id = 'acme-corp-42' AND ts >= '2024-02-20' AND ts < '2024-02-22' GROUP BY day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE(ts) as day, 'billing' as source, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM billing_agg WHERE account_id = 'acme-corp-42' AND ts >= '2024-02-20' AND ts < '2024-02-22' GROUP BY day
) GROUP BY day, source ORDER BY day, source;
```

Anya (eng): Ran it — quick paste of results:

```
2024-02-20 raw  610,432
2024-02-20 billing  834,567
2024-02-21 raw  369,999
2024-02-21 billing  369,999
```

Anya (eng): Looks like Feb 20 billing shows ~224,135 extra tokens compared to raw. That's the delta.

Maria B.: That smells like a duplication during aggregation boundary on the plan-change day. Any recent deploys to billing-processor around Feb 20? :thinking_face:

Sam S.: Deploy bot shows a billing-processor deploy at 2024-02-20 11:58 UTC (deploy-768). Also customer rotated API keys at ~12:03 UTC per Acme Ops note.

Acme Ops: We rotated keys to switch to the new ProPlus plan as part of the upgrade. Nothing else on our side.

Leo F.: If keys were rotated, the aggregator might have reprocessed queued events or the idempotency key lookup could have missed a namespace after the plan-change. Check event_ingest logs for duplicated request_ids around 11:50-12:20 UTC.

Anya (eng): Found repeated request_id set r_9f3a1b appearing twice in raw_events with slightly different metadata (old_plan/proplus flag). Looks like the event re-ingest path replayed items after deploy when the plan change happened. Will run a de-dup and reconcile.

Maria B.: Please hold on adjustments until finance signs off, but this is actionable. Maria -> Leo/Finance: can you compute what invoice delta would be if we subtract the duplicated tokens for Feb 20?

Leo F.: Quick calc: duplicate ~224,135 tokens * $0.005/token = $1,120.675 -> rounds to $1,120.68. Remaining difference ~ $66.66 probably rounding/PRORATE on plan change.

Billing Bot: Ticket BB-1287 created for invoice reconciliation (linked to INV-2024-02-42). Assigned to @Leo F., @Maria B. :white_check_mark:

Sam S.: Acme wants a timeline & potential credit. I'll tell them we're investigating and may issue a credit if duplication confirmed.

Anya (eng): Action items: 1) run idempotency backfill to remove duplicates for 2024-02-20 (I will run and post results), 2) produce reconciled billing_agg snapshot and diff, 3) coordinate with finance for invoice adj. ETA for backfill: 2 hours.

Maria B.: Thanks. @Acme Ops can you confirm whether any webhook retries were in flight around noon that might have retried with new key?

Acme Ops: We did not see retries on our side — only a single call to /subscriptions/upgrade.

Leo F.: I'll hold off on invoicing change until the backfill result. If duplication removal reduces invoice by ~$1,120.68 we'll propose a credit and explain the rounding proration separately.

Sam S.: Great — please update this thread when backfill finishes. I'll draft a customer message template with timeline + proposed credit. :+1:

Anya (eng): Backfill done. Removed 224,135 duplicated tokens from billing_agg for 2024-02-20. Re-run diffs: billing now matches raw for that window. Dropped invoice amount by $1,120.68. Posting reconciliation CSV to the finance bucket now.

Leo F.: Confirmed the CSV and adjusted invoice delta. Finance OK to issue credit of $1,120.68 and a rounding/proration explanation of $66.66. Will update INV-2024-02-42 and notify Sam when credit is applied.

Maria B.: Noted — I'll wait for final invoice update before messaging Acme.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2024-02-42 updated, credit applied BB-1287-CR (amount $1,120.68).

Sam S.: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
